groupings.title: Slavic
groupings.description: Russian — the original version of the skill, built around Maxim Ilyahov's «Пиши, сокращай» (Write, Shorten).

groupings.title: Germanic
groupings.description: English and German adaptations — with native filler words, idioms, and a focus on bureaucratese (Behördendeutsch, Nominalstil, Denglisch).

groupings.title: Romance
groupings.description: Catalan, Spanish, French, and Italian adaptations — with native clichés, lenguaje administrativo, langue de bois, burocratese, and language-specific traps like pronoms febles and cadenas de "de".
